title: Synergistic polyherbal formulation based on Triphala for metabolic regulation and gut barrier repair
text: A standardized herbal composition comprising equal weight proportions of aqueous-ethanolic extracts of Terminalia chebula, Terminalia bellerica, and Phyllanthus emblica, characterized by polyphenol content >= 45% and gallic acid >= 8%, restoring gut mucosal tightness and reducing metabolic endotoxemia.
